summary.headline: April adds major compliance, least-privilege, and tenant-attach security references
summary.overview: April's high-volume archive introduces Android AOSP compliance settings, Endpoint Privilege Management guidance for transitioning users to standard accounts, and Intune endpoint-security firewall settings for Configuration Manager devices. It also contains broad documentation maintenance across Intune and Security Copilot.
summary.adminImpact: Use the new Android and EPM references to inform compliance and privileged-access programs. Co-management teams should validate firewall policy design against the tenant-attach documentation before implementation.
